sentences.en: Yanni broke a bottle and slashed Ziri across the throat.
sentences.zh: 雅尼打破了瓶子并对齐里砍了脖子一刀。

sentences.en: He was slashed with a wide cicatrice of scar tissue.
sentences.zh: 他的脸上有一道宽大的伤疤。

sentences.en: Do not buy now; they will soon be slashing the prices.
sentences.zh: 现在不要买；他们很快会大幅降价。
